name: Moonlit Glass Grove
description: A grove of towering glass trees whose leaves tinkle like wind chimes under a full moon, casting prismatic shadows.
prompt: A forest of massive glass trees — trunks of clear crystal, branches of faceted glass leaves. Moonlight passes through, scattering rainbow shafts onto a mossy floor. Gentle breeze implied by slight leaf tilt. Photorealistic, magical atmosphere, 8K.
caption: Where moonlight plays a symphony on glass leaves. 🌕🌳 #MoonlitGlassGrove
